examples.rules_text: Shining Wonder — RR: Choose up to this creature's power targets. A target may be chosen more than once. This creature deals 1 damage to each of those targets in the order chosen. If any of those targets becomes illegal before it is dealt damage this way, counter this ability.

This spell costs 1 more to cast for each target beyond the first. /n Zoltraak deals X damage divided evenly, rounded down, among any number of targets. If the target is a demon, it deals double that damage instead.
T1: Tap target creature. It loses all abilities until the beginning of its controllers upkeep.
Deathtouch, Menace \n 2U: Put a Empathy counter on target Mage or Wizard creature. \n Übel, Empathetic Psycopath has all the activated abilities of creatures with a Empathy counter on them

When The Hero’s Journey enters the battlefield, discard your hand. If you do, search your library for a Cleric, Hero, Mage, and Warrior creature card with different names, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then shuffle. \n This card can be your commander.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell during your turn, counter it unless its controller pays 2. \n Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery during an opponent's turn, draw a card, then discard a card.
Scry 3 \n You may cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 2 or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Draw two cards, then discard two cards.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, exile the top card of your library. \n You may play instant and sorcery cards exiled with {cardName}.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 1 or less, draw a card. \n T2: Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Add one mana of any color.
T2: Create a copy of {cardName} except it isn't legendary and has haste. At the beginning of your end step, exile the copy.
Surveil 2, then choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

This spell costs {1} less to cast for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard. \n Reach \n Whenever {cardName} attacks, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
Trample, reach \n Converge - This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each color of mana spent to cast it.
Return target nonland permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield. \n Paradigm
Create two 2/2 red and white Spirit creature tokens. Then if this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit you control. \n Flashback {4}{W}{W}
